common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.tagline: A calm place to track your spending in MVR.
auth.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

errors.invalid: That email or password isn't right.
errors.exists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
errors.unconfirmed: Please confirm your email first. We sent you a link.
errors.rate: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.

auth.linkSent: Check your email for the sign-in link.
auth.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Open the Kharadhu app and sign in.
auth.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. If you haven't signed in yet, try signing in: your email may already be confirmed. Otherwise open the Kharadhu app and ask for the email again.
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to see your spending.
auth.signUpSubtitle: It takes a minute. Your data stays private.
auth.agreeNext: You will review our terms and privacy policy in the next step.
auth.linkSentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}.

home.noBudget: No budget set for this month.
home.emptyBody: Add your first expense, or scan a receipt with Raseedhu.

expense.rateHint: 1 {{code}} = how many MVR? You enter this yourself.
expense.invalidRate: Enter an exchange rate, for example 15.42.

scan.title: Raseedhu
scan.subtitle: Photograph a receipt and we'll fill in the details for you to check.
scan.noScans: You've used all {{limit}} free scans this month. They come back on the 1st. You can still add expenses by hand.
scan.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. You can allow it in Settings, or choose a photo from your gallery.
scan.unreadable: We couldn't read this receipt clearly. Try a new photo in good light, or fill it in by hand. This didn't use a scan.
scan.offline: No connection. Your photo is still here — try again when you're back online. This didn't use a scan.
scan.failed: The scan didn't work this time. It didn't use up a scan. Please try again.

confirm.title: Check and save
confirm.intro: Check each detail before saving. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.
confirm.lowConfidence: We're not sure about this one.
confirm.mismatchTitle: The items don't add up to the total
confirm.mismatchBody: Items {{items}} + GST {{gst}} = {{expected}}, but the receipt total is {{total}}. Check the amounts below.
confirm.matchOk: Items and GST match the total.
confirm.leaveBody: This receipt hasn't been saved yet.

budget.title: Budget
budget.hint: Set a limit, and we'll show how you're doing. Limits are for this month and the months after.

reports.title: Reports
reports.empty: No spending in this month yet.

more.title: More
more.about: Kharadhu helps you see where your money goes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ratesNote: Enter the rates yourself. We fill in the last rate you used.
settings.biometric: Lock the app with Face ID or fingerprint
settings.biometricUnavailable: Set up Face ID or a fingerprint on your phone first.
settings.keepPhotosNote: By default the photo is deleted after we read it, and only the details are kept.

debts.title: Debt-free plan
debts.amanah: A debt is an amanah, a trust. Paying it back promptly is a kindness to yourself and to the person you owe.
debts.neverPays: At this amount the balance isn't going down. A little more each month would change that.
debts.noDebtsBody: Add a debt to see a plan for paying it off. There's no rush.
debts.snowballHint: Clear small debts quickly and roll their payments forward.
debts.interestNote: Interest-bearing debts are marked so you can decide what to clear first. This is guidance, not a ruling.
debts.inRegister: Include in my register for my family
debts.inRegisterNote: Trusted people see it only after a confirmed passing.
debts.notesHint: Please don't write account numbers or passwords here.
debts.deleteBody: Its payment history will be deleted too.

giving.title: Giving
giving.intro: Giving is a gentle habit. Every amount counts, and there is no pressure.
giving.goalReached: You've reached your goal this month. May it be accepted.
giving.recipientHint: Private. Only you can see this.
giving.obligations: Zakat and other obligations this month: {{amount}}
giving.deleteBody: The matching expense is removed too.
giving.countsNote: Sadaqah and sadaqah jariyah count toward your goal. Zakat and other obligations are kept separate.

zakat.title: Zakat date and goal
zakat.dateHint: The Hijri date your zakat year ends, if you keep one.
zakat.adjustHint: Moon sighting can differ by a day. Choose the date that matches yours.
zakat.reminderNote: A week before and on the day. The reminder never shows amounts.
zakat.permissionDenied: Notifications are off for Kharadhu. You can allow them in your phone's settings.
zakat.guidance: Zakat is a personal obligation that depends on your situation. Please ask a trusted scholar about your own case. Kharadhu only helps you remember.
zakat.notifWeek: A gentle reminder: your zakat date is a week away.
zakat.notifDay: A gentle reminder: your zakat date is today.

register.title: Wasiyyah & Amanah
register.intro: A private list of what your family should know: debts owed, money owed to you, giving still to do, trusts and wishes. Nothing is shared with anyone while you're well. Please never write passwords, PINs, card or ID numbers here.
register.ready: You're ready. Nothing is shared unless the people you trust confirm.
register.itemsEmpty: Nothing here yet. Your debts from the Debt-free plan are included automatically, if you chose that.
register.detailsHint: Encrypted. Please don't write passwords, PINs or card numbers.
register.honest: This is private, and kept encrypted. Honest note: Kharadhu's own database administrator could technically read it, as our privacy policy explains.

contacts.title: People you trust
contacts.intro: Choose up to three people. They see nothing now. If you can't be reached for a long time, they're asked to check on you, and your list opens only when they confirm.
contacts.revokeBody: They'll no longer be asked, and can't see anything.
contacts.name: Their name
contacts.inviterName: How should you appear to them?
contacts.consent: I agree that Kharadhu shares this person's name and email with its email service (Resend) so it can send them messages, and that they will be told why they were chosen.
contacts.shareText: {{who}} would like you to be someone they trust in Kharadhu. Please open this link: {{link}}
contacts.linkNote: The link works for 7 days and only once. Send it to them yourself.
contacts.appUrlMissing: The invite web address isn't set up yet.

release.title: Check-ins and away mode
release.intro: If you haven't opened Kharadhu for a long time, we first check in with you by email, twice. Only if there's still no answer are the people you trust asked to check on you. Nothing opens because of silence alone.

state.active: You're active. Nothing is being asked of anyone.
state.quiet: We've checked in with you. Open the app to let us know you're okay.
state.second_checkin: We've checked in twice. Open the app to let us know you're okay.
state.contacts_asked: The people you trust have been asked to check on you. Opening the app now stops this.
state.released: Your list has been opened to the people you trust.

release.awayNote: Travelling, on Hajj or Umrah, or in hospital? Pause check-ins for a while (up to 90 days).

events.release_blocked: An attempt to open it was refused
events.answer_withdrawn: A trusted person changed their mind

accept.title: A request from someone you may know
accept.body: {{who}} would like you to be one of the people they trust. You'd only be asked if they can't be reached for a long time, to check on them. You'd see their list of debts and wishes only if you and others confirm they have passed away. You can say no.
accept.accepted: Thank you. You're now one of their trusted people. Nothing is needed from you now.
accept.declined: No problem. We've let them know you declined.
accept.expired: This invite has expired. Please ask them for a new one.
accept.used: This invite has already been used.
accept.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

contactSide.title: For someone who trusts me
contactSide.intro: Here you'll see anyone who has asked you to be a trusted person, once they can't be reached. Please sign in with the same email address they invited.
contactSide.none: No one needs anything from you right now.
contactSide.asked: {{who}} can't be reached. Please check on them if you can, then tell us.
contactSide.passedBody: Please only choose this if you know they have passed away. Their list opens only when others confirm too, and they will be told straight away.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.body: This removes your account and everything in it: spending, debts, giving, your register, your trusted people and your receipt photos. It can't be undone.
deleteAccount.failed: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again, or contact us.
deleteAccount.privacyMissing: The privacy policy address isn't set up yet.

legal.title: Before you start
legal.intro: Please read and agree to these to use Kharadhu. You can read each in full first.
legal.terms: I agree to the Terms of Service
legal.privacy: I have read the Privacy Policy
legal.urlMissing: The legal pages aren't published yet.
legal.failed: We couldn't save that. Please try again.

deleteInfo.title: Delete your Kharadhu account
deleteInfo.intro: You can delete your account and all of your data yourself, any time.
deleteInfo.step3: Choose Delete my account and type DELETE.
deleteInfo.what: This removes your spending, debts, giving, register, trusted people and receipt photos. It can't be undone.
deleteInfo.help: If you can't sign in, email us from the address on your account and we'll delete it for you.
deleteInfo.emailMissing: The support email address isn't set up yet.
deleteInfo.signIn: Sign in here to delete it

webHome.body: The website is for people invited as a trusted person, and for deleting your account. For everything else, please use the Kharadhu app on your phone.

trend.title: Last 6 months
trend.average: Average spending {{amount}} a month. Tap a month to see it.

onboarding.p1Body: Log your spending in MVR in seconds, or photograph a receipt and let Raseedhu read it for you.
onboarding.p2Title: Pay debts down. Give with intention.
onboarding.p2Body: A calm plan to become debt-free, and a place to keep track of your sadaqah and zakat.
onboarding.p3Body: Your list of debts and wishes stays private. It opens to people you trust only if they confirm, never because of silence alone.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it, then come back to Kharadhu and sign in.
checkEmail.tip: Can't find it? Look in your spam or junk folder.
checkEmail.resendIn: You can send it again in {{seconds}} seconds
checkEmail.failed: We couldn't send it. Please try again in a minute.

setup.title: Let's get you started
setup.body: One quick thing. You can change it any time.
setup.budgetHint: How much do you plan to spend each month? We'll show how you're doing.
setup.tip: Tip: tap the round button at the bottom to scan a receipt.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: Pick a password you have not used before.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Open the Kharadhu app and sign in with it.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new reset link in the app.
reset.none: Open the reset link from your email to choose a new password.
